<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="ru">

<head>

    <meta charset="UTF-8">

    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">

    <title>Наша история ❤️</title>

<link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="icon-192.png">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#7b4b8c">

    <style>

        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        body { font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'Lucida Sans Unicode', sans-serif; background: #f3e8f7; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; min-height: 100vh; padding: 16px; }

        .app { max-width: 420px; width: 100%; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 28px; box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(123, 75, 140, 0.12); overflow: hidden; padding: 24px 18px 28px; text-align: center; min-height: 560px; position: relative; }

        .page { display: none; animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease; }

        .page.active { display: block; }

        @keyframes fadeIn { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

        .emoji-big { font-size: 44px; display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; }

        h1 { font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: #7b4b8c; margin-bottom: 2px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }

        .subtitle { font-size: 16px; color: #b38cc4; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 12px; }

        .date { font-size: 14px; color: #b8a0c4; margin-bottom: 14px; }

        .description { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; color: #3d2f44; background: #f7f0fa; padding: 16px; border-radius: 18px; margin-bottom: 16px; text-align: left; }

        .timer { background: #f7f0fa; border-radius: 18px; padding: 14px 10px; margin: 10px 0 16px; display: flex; justify-content: space-around; flex-wrap: wrap; }

        .timer-item { text-align: center; min-width: 60px; }

        .timer-number { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #7b4b8c; display: block; line-height: 1.2; }

        .timer-label { font-size: 12px; color: #b38cc4; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }

        .calendar { background: #f7f0fa; border-radius: 18px; padding: 14px 10px; margin: 8px 0 14px; }

        .calendar-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-weight: 600; color: #7b4b8c; margin-bottom: 10px; }

        .calendar-weekdays { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #b38cc4; margin-bottom: 6px; }

        .calendar-days { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr); gap: 4px; }

        .calendar-day { padding: 6px 0; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 30px; background: transparent; color: #3d2f44; }

        .calendar-day.highlight { background: #c62828; color: white; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 30px; position: relative; }

        .calendar-day.highlight::after { content: "❤️"; font-size: 10px; display: block; margin-top: -2px; }

        .calendar-day.other-month { color: #ccc; }

        .nav-btn { background: #a8d5b5; color: #2e3d30; border: none; padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: 40px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.25s; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(125, 187, 140, 0.2); margin: 4px 2px; }

        .nav-btn:hover { background: #7dbb8c; transform: scale(0.97); }

        .nav-btn.outline { background: transparent; color: #7b4b8c; box-shadow: none; border: 2px solid #c9b1d6; }

        .nav-btn.outline:hover { background: #f0e6f5; }

        .nav-btn.hidden { visibility: hidden; }

        .nav-buttons { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin-top: 18px; }

        .menu-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; margin: 12px 0; }

        .menu-item { background: #f7f0fa; border-radius: 18px; padding: 16px 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; border: 2px solid transparent; }

        .menu-item:hover { border-color: #c9b1d6; background: #f0e6f5; }

        .menu-item .emoji { font-size: 28px; display: block; }

        .menu-item .label { font-size: 14px; color: #3d2f44; margin-top: 4px; }

        .carousel { position: relative; margin: 10px 0 14px; }

        .carousel-images { display: flex; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 18px; background: #f7f0fa; min-height: 200px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; position: relative; }

        .carousel-images img { width: 100%; max-height: 240px; object-fit: cover; display: none; border-radius: 18px; }

        .carousel-images img.active { display: block; }

        .carousel-arrows { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 8px; }

        .carousel-arrows button { background: #c9b1d6; border: none; color: white; font-size: 20px; padding: 4px 16px; border-radius: 30px; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; }

        .carousel-arrows button:hover { background: #b38cc4; }

        .footer { margin-top: 18px; font-size: 13px; color: #b8a0c4; border-top: 1px solid #efe6f5; padding-top: 14px; }

        .footer span { color: #7b4b8c; font-weight: 500; }

        .upload-btn { background: #c62828; color: white; border: none; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 40px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.25s; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(198, 40, 40, 0.2); margin: 8px 0; width: 100%; }

        .upload-btn:hover { background: #b71c1c; transform: scale(0.97); }

        .delete-btn { background: #c9b1d6; color: #3d2f44; border: none; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 30px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.25s; margin: 2px; }

        .delete-btn:hover { background: #b38cc4; }

        #uploadStatus { font-size: 14px; color: #7dbb8c; font-weight: 600; margin: 6px 0; min-height: 24px; }

        .word-item { background: #f7f0fa; border-radius: 18px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-align: left; position: relative; }

        .word-item .text { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; color: #3d2f44; padding-right: 60px; }

        .word-item .delete-btn { position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px; }

        .words-container { margin: 12px 0; max-height: 300px; overflow-y: auto; }

        .carousel-delete { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; background: rgba(198, 40, 40, 0.8); color: white; border: none; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 20px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; z-index: 5; }

        .carousel-delete:hover { background: rgba(198, 40, 40, 1); }

        .carousel-wrapper { position: relative; }

        #fileInput { display: none; }

        .input-url { width: 100%; padding: 10px; border: 2px solid #c9b1d6; border-radius: 18px; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #3d2f44; background: #fcfaff; margin-bottom: 10px; }

        .input-url:focus { outline: none; border-color: #7b4b8c; }

        .loading { color: #b38cc4; padding: 20px; }

        .error { color: #c62828; padding: 20px; }

        .player { margin: 10px 0; }

        .player audio { width: 100%; border-radius: 18px; background: #f7f0fa; outline: none; }

        .player audio::-webkit-media-controls-panel { background: #f7f0fa; }

        .player iframe { width: 100%; border-radius: 18px; border: none; }

        .quiz-card { background: #f7f0fa; border-radius: 18px; padding: 16px; margin: 12px 0; }

        .quiz-question { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #7b4b8c; margin-bottom: 12px; }

        .quiz-option { background: white; border: 2px solid #c9b1d6; border-radius: 40px; padding: 10px; margin: 8px 0; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.2s; }

        .quiz-option:hover { border-color: #7b4b8c; background: #f0e6f5; }

        .quiz-option.correct { border-color: #7dbb8c; background: #e6f5ea; }

        .quiz-option.wrong { border-color: #c62828; background: #fce4ec; }

        .quiz-option.disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.6; }

        .quiz-result { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; margin: 12px 0; }

        .quiz-result.correct { color: #7dbb8c; }

        .quiz-result.wrong { color: #c62828; }

        .quiz-person { display: inline-block; margin: 4px 8px; padding: 4px 16px; border-radius: 40px; font-weight: 600; background: #f0e6f5; color: #7b4b8c; }

        .quiz-person.you { background: #c62828; color: white; }

        .quiz-person.me { background: #a8d5b5; color: #2e3d30; }

        .place-card { background: white; border-radius: 18px; padding: 12px; margin: 8px 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border: 2px solid #f0e6f5; }

        .place-card .emoji { font-size: 24px; }

        .place-card .info { text-align: left; flex: 1; }

        .place-card .info .name { font-weight: 600; color: #7b4b8c; }

        .place-card .info .desc { font-size: 13px; color: #b38cc4; }

        .map-container { background: #f0e6f5; border-radius: 18px; padding: 12px; margin: 8px 0; min-height: 180px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 2px dashed #c9b1d6; }

        .map-container iframe { width: 100%; border-radius: 18px; border: none; height: 250px; }

        .main-photo { width: 100%; border-radius: 18px; margin-bottom: 16px; border: 2px solid #f0e6f5; }

        .section-desc { font-size: 13px; color: #b8a0c4; margin-bottom: 12px; text-align: center; }

    </style>

</head>

<script>

    // ==============================================================

    // FIREBASE

    // ==============================================================

    const firebaseConfig = {

        apiKey: "AIzaSyCNY4JjnLGt5Nr0h3EKeQ3pqq6DOKpLJos",

        authDomain: "love-history-eb47d.firebaseapp.com",

        databaseURL: "https://love-history-eb47d-default-rtdb.europe-west1.firebasedatabase.app",

        messagingSenderId: "247930053843",

    };

 

    firebase.initializeApp(firebaseConfig);

    const database = firebase.database();

 

    // ==============================================================

    // НАВИГАЦИЯ

    // ==============================================================

    function goToPage(n) {

        document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));

        document.getElementById('page' + n).classList.add('active');

    }

 

    // ==============================================================

    // ТАЙМЕР

    // ==============================================================

    function updateTimer() {

        const start = new Date('2023-01-28T00:00:00');

        const now = new Date();

        let diff = (now - start) / 1000;

        const years = Math.floor(diff / (365.25 * 24 * 3600));

        diff -= years * 365.25 * 24 * 3600;

        const months = Math.floor(diff / (30.44 * 24 * 3600));

        diff -= months * 30.44 * 24 * 3600;

        const days = Math.floor(diff / (24 * 3600));

        diff -= days * 24 * 3600;

        const hours = Math.floor(diff / 3600);

        document.getElementById('years').textContent = years;

        document.getElementById('months').textContent = months;

        document.getElementById('days').textContent = days;

        document.getElementById('hours').textContent = hours;

    }

    updateTimer();

    setInterval(updateTimer, 60000);

 

    // ==============================================================

    // КАЛЕНДАРЬ

    // ==============================================================

    function renderCalendar() {

        const year = 2023;

        const month = 0;

        const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1).getDay();

        const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();

        let startOffset = (firstDay === 0) ? 6 : firstDay - 1;

        let html = `

            <div style="font-size:14px; color:#7b4b8c; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:8px;">

                ❤️ В этот день началась наша история ❤️

            </div>

            <div class="calendar-header">

                <span>${getMonthName(month)} ${year}</span>

            </div>

            <div class="calendar-weekdays">

                <span>Пн</span><span>Вт</span><span>Ср</span><span>Чт</span><span>Пт</span><span>Сб</span><span>Вс</span>

            </div>

            <div class="calendar-days">

        `;

        for (let i = 0; i < startOffset; i++) {

            html += `<div class="calendar-day other-month"></div>`;

        }

        for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {

            const isHighlight = (d === 28);

            html += `<div class="${isHighlight ? 'calendar-day highlight' : 'calendar-day'}">${d}</div>`;

        }

        html += `</div>`;

        document.getElementById('calendar').innerHTML = html;

    }

    let currentSlide = 0;

    const photoUrls = [

        // ★★★★★ ВСТАВЬ ССЫЛКИ НА СВОИ ФОТО ★★★★★

    ];

 

    function updateCarousel() {

        const container = document.getElementById('carouselImages');

        container.innerHTML = '';

        if (photoUrls.length === 0) {

            container.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:40px 0; color:#b38cc4;">Добавьте фото в код 📸</div>';

            return;

        }

        photoUrls.forEach((url, index) => {

            const wrapper = document.createElement('div');

            wrapper.style.position = 'relative';

            wrapper.style.width = '100%';

 

            const img = document.createElement('img');

            img.src = url;

            img.className = index === 0 ? 'active' : '';

            img.alt = 'Наше фото';

            wrapper.appendChild(img);

 

            container.appendChild(wrapper);

        });

        currentSlide = 0;

        showSlide(0);

    }

 

    function showSlide(index) {

        const wrappers = document.querySelectorAll('#carouselImages > div');

        wrappers.forEach((wrapper, i) => {

            const img = wrapper.querySelector('img');

            if (img) {

                img.classList.toggle('active', i === index);

            }

        });

    }

 

    function nextSlide() {

        if (photoUrls.length === 0) return;

        currentSlide = (currentSlide + 1) % photoUrls.length;

        showSlide(currentSlide);

    }

 

    function prevSlide() {

        if (photoUrls.length === 0) return;

        currentSlide = (currentSlide - 1 + photoUrls.length) % photoUrls.length;

        showSlide(currentSlide);

    }

    function loadWords() {

        const container = document.getElementById('wordsContainer');

        database.ref('words').on('value', (snapshot) => {

            container.innerHTML = '';

            const data = snapshot.val();

            if (!data) {

                container.innerHTML = '<div class="loading">Пока нет тёплых слов 💬</div>';

                return;

            }

            const keys = Object.keys(data).reverse();

            keys.forEach(key => {

                const item = document.createElement('div');

                item.className = 'word-item';

                const text = data[key].text || data[key];

                item.innerHTML = `

                    <span class="text">${text}</span>

                    <button class="delete-btn" onclick="deleteWord('${key}')">🗑️</button>

                `;

                container.appendChild(item);

            });

        });

    }

 

    function addWord() {

        const input = document.getElementById('wordsInput');

        const text = input.value.trim();

        const status = document.getElementById('wordsStatus');

 

        if (!text) {

            status.textContent = '❌ Напиши что-нибудь!';

            status.style.color = '#c62828';

            return;

        }

 

        database.ref('words').push({ text: text })

            .then(() => {

                status.textContent = '✅ Добавлено! ✨';

                status.style.color = '#7dbb8c';

                input.value = '';

            })

            .catch((error) => {

                status.textContent = '❌ Ошибка: ' + error.message;

                status.style.color = '#c62828';

                console.error('Ошибка добавления:', error);

            });

    }

 

    function deleteWord(key) {

        if (confirm('Удалить это пожелание?')) {

            database.ref('words/' + key).remove();

        }

    }

        "Что я делаю, что заставляет тебя чувствовать себя неуверенным(ой) в нашей вере друг в друга?"

    ];

 

    openQuestions.forEach(q => {

        allQuestions.push({

            type: 'open',

            question: q

        });

    });

 

    // ==============================================================

    // ЛОГИКА ВИКТОРИНЫ (СИНХРОНИЗАЦИЯ)

    // ==============================================================

    let currentPlayer = null;

    let currentQuestionIndex = 0;

    let playerAnswers = [];

    let otherPlayerAnswers = [];

    let quizActive = false;

    let playerCompleted = false;

    let otherPlayerCompleted = false;

    let currentQuestions = [];

    let playerKey = '';

    let otherKey = '';

 

    function getRandomQuestions() {

        const shuffled = [...allQuestions].sort(() => 0.5 - Math.random());

        return shuffled.slice(0, 10);

    }

 

    function selectPlayer(player) {

        currentPlayer = player;

        playerAnswers = [];

        otherPlayerAnswers = [];

        playerCompleted = false;

        otherPlayerCompleted = false;

        currentQuestionIndex = 0;

        quizActive = true;

 

        document.getElementById('playerSelect').style.display = 'none';

        document.getElementById('quizContainer').style.display = 'block';

        document.getElementById('finalResult').style.display = 'none';

 

        database.ref('quiz/sessionId').once('value', (snapshot) => {

            const existingSession = snapshot.val();

            if (existingSession) {

                database.ref('quiz').update({

                    player2: player,

                    player2Answers: []

                });

                loadQuestionsFromFirebase();

            } else {

                const newQuestions = getRandomQuestions();

                currentQuestions = newQuestions;

                database.ref('quiz').set({

                    sessionId: 'session_' + Date.now(),

                    questions: newQuestions,

                    player1: player,

                    player1Answers: [],

                    player2: null,

                    player2Answers: [],

                    player1Completed: false,

                    player2Completed: false,

                    started: true

                });

                renderQuiz();

            }

        });

 

        listenQuizUpdates();

    }

 

    function loadQuestionsFromFirebase() {

        database.ref('quiz/questions').once('value', (snapshot) => {

            const questions = snapshot.val();

            if (questions) {

                currentQuestions = questions;

                renderQuiz();

            }

        });

    }

 

    function renderQuiz() {

        const container = document.getElementById('quizContainer');

        if (!quizActive || currentQuestionIndex >= currentQuestions.length) {

            return;

        }

 

        const q = currentQuestions[currentQuestionIndex];

        let html = `

            <div style="font-size: 14px; color: #b8a0c4; margin-bottom: 8px;">Вопрос ${currentQuestionIndex + 1} из 10</div>

            <div class="quiz-question">${q.question}</div>

        `;

 

        if (q.type === 'closed') {

            html += `<div style="margin: 12px 0;">`;

            q.options.forEach(option => {

                html += `

                    <button class="quiz-option" onclick="submitClosedAnswer('${option}')">${option}</button>

                `;

            });

            html += `</div>`;

        } else {

            html += `

                <textarea id="answerInput" class="input-url" rows="2" placeholder="Напиши свой ответ..." style="margin-top: 12px;"></textarea>

                <button class="upload-btn" onclick="submitOpenAnswer()" style="background: #a8d5b5; color: #2e3d30; margin-top: 12px;">✅ Ответить</button>

            `;

        }

 

        html += `<div id="quizResult" class="quiz-result"></div>`;

        container.innerHTML = html;

    }

 

    function submitClosedAnswer(answer) {

        const resultDiv = document.getElementById('quizResult');

        const options = document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-option');

        options.forEach(opt => opt.classList.add('disabled'));

 

        playerAnswers.push(answer);

        const playerKey = currentPlayer === 'you' ? 'player1Answers' : 'player2Answers';

        database.ref('quiz/' + playerKey).set(playerAnswers);

 

        resultDiv.textContent = '✅ Ответ принят!';

        resultDiv.className = 'quiz-result correct';

 

        setTimeout(() => {

            currentQuestionIndex++;

            if (currentQuestionIndex >= currentQuestions.length) {

                const completedKey = currentPlayer === 'you' ? 'player1Completed' : 'player2Completed';

                database.ref('quiz/' + completedKey).set(true);

                checkBothCompleted();

            } else {

                renderQuiz();

            }

        }, 800);

    }

 

    function submitOpenAnswer() {

        const input = document.getElementById('answerInput');

        const answer = input.value.trim();

        const resultDiv = document.getElementById('quizResult');

 

        if (!answer) {

            resultDiv.textContent = '❌ Напиши ответ!';

            resultDiv.className = 'quiz-result wrong';

            return;

        }

 

        playerAnswers.push(answer);

        input.disabled = true;

 

        const playerKey = currentPlayer === 'you' ? 'player1Answers' : 'player2Answers';

        database.ref('quiz/' + playerKey).set(playerAnswers);

 

        resultDiv.textContent = '✅ Ответ принят!';

        resultDiv.className = 'quiz-result correct';

 

        setTimeout(() => {

            currentQuestionIndex++;

            if (currentQuestionIndex >= currentQuestions.length) {

                const completedKey = currentPlayer === 'you' ? 'player1Completed' : 'player2Completed';

                database.ref('quiz/' + completedKey).set(true);

                checkBothCompleted();

            } else {

                renderQuiz();

            }

        }, 800);

    }

 

    function checkBothCompleted() {

        database.ref('quiz').once('value', (snapshot) => {

            const data = snapshot.val();

            if (data && data.player1Completed && data.player2Completed) {

                showFinalResult();

            }

        });

    }

 

    // ==============================================================

    // ФУНКЦИЯ ДЛЯ РАСЧЁТА СОВМЕСТИМОСТИ

    // ==============================================================

    function calculateCompatibility(player1Answers, player2Answers) {

        if (!player1Answers || !player2Answers || player1Answers.length === 0 || player2Answers.length === 0) {

            return { percentage: 0, phrase: "Вы ещё не ответили на все вопросы! 😅" };

        }

 

        let matches = 0;

        const total = Math.min(player1Answers.length, player2Answers.length);

 

        for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {

            if (player1Answers[i] === player2Answers[i]) {

                matches++;

            }

        }

 

        const percentage = Math.round((matches / 10) * 100);

 

        let phrase = '';

        if (percentage >= 90) {

            phrase = "🌟 Вы — идеальная пара! Ваши души танцуют в унисон. Берегите друг друга! ❤️";

        } else if (percentage >= 70) {

            phrase = "💞 Вы очень близки! У вас есть всё, чтобы построить крепкие отношения. Продолжайте в том же духе!";

        } else if (percentage >= 50) {

            phrase = "💕 Вы хорошая пара! Немного больше понимания — и вы будете непобедимы. Общайтесь чаще!";

        } else if (percentage >= 30) {

            phrase = "🤔 Вы разные, но это не плохо! Противоположности притягиваются. Просто учитесь слушать друг друга.";

        } else {

            phrase = "😅 У вас очень разные взгляды на жизнь! Но это делает ваши отношения интересными. Главное — уважать друг друга!";

        }

 

        return { percentage, phrase };

    }

 

    // ==============================================================

    // ОБНОВЛЁННАЯ ФУНКЦИЯ ПОКАЗА РЕЗУЛЬТАТА

    // ==============================================================

    function showFinalResult() {

        const container = document.getElementById('quizContainer');

        container.style.display = 'none';

        const finalDiv = document.getElementById('finalResult');

        finalDiv.style.display = 'block';

 

        database.ref('quiz').once('value', (snapshot) => {

            const data = snapshot.val();

            if (!data) return;

 

            const player1Answers = data.player1Answers || [];

            const player2Answers = data.player2Answers || [];

            const questions = data.questions || [];

 

            const { percentage, phrase } = calculateCompatibility(player1Answers, player2Answers);

 

            let html = `

                <div style="font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #7b4b8c; margin-bottom: 12px;">💞 Ваша совместимость</div>

                <div style="font-size: 48px; font-weight: 700; color: #c62828;">${percentage}%</div>

                <div style="font-size: 16px; color: #3d2f44; margin: 12px 0;">${phrase}</div>

                <div style="font-size: 14px; color: #b8a0c4; margin-bottom: 16px;">Совпадений: ${Math.round((percentage / 100) * 10)} из 10</div>

                <div style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #7b4b8c; margin-bottom: 12px;">📋 Сравните ваши ответы</div>

            `;

 

            for (let i = 0; i < questions.length; i++) {

                const q = questions[i];

                const p1Answer = player1Answers[i] || '—';

                const p2Answer = player2Answers[i] || '—';

               

                html += `

                    <div style="background: #f7f0fa; border-radius: 18px; padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px; text-align: left;">

                        <div style="font-weight: 600; color: #7b4b8c; margin-bottom: 4px;">${i + 1}. ${q.question}</div>

                        <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 14px;">

                            <span style="color: #c62828;">👩 ${data.player1 === 'you' ? 'Я' : 'Он/Она'}: ${p1Answer}</span>

                            <span style="color: #7dbb8c;">👨 ${data.player2 === 'me' ? 'Он/Она' : 'Я'}: ${p2Answer}</span>

                        </div>

                    </div>

                `;

            }

 

            html += `

                <button class="upload-btn" onclick="resetQuiz()" style="background: #a8d5b5; color: #2e3d30; margin-top: 12px;">🔄 Играть снова (новые вопросы)</button>

            `;

 

            finalDiv.innerHTML = html;

        });

    }

 

    function listenQuizUpdates() {

        database.ref('quiz').on('value', (snapshot) => {

            const data = snapshot.val();

            if (!data) return;

 

            if (!currentQuestions.length && data.questions) {

                currentQuestions = data.questions;

                if (document.getElementById('quizContainer').style.display !== 'none' && !document.getElementById('quizContainer').innerHTML) {

                    renderQuiz();

                }

            }

 

            if (data.player1Completed && data.player2Completed) {

                showFinalResult();

            }

        });

    }

 

    function resetQuiz() {

        currentQuestionIndex = 0;

        playerAnswers = [];

        otherPlayerAnswers = [];

        playerCompleted = false;

        otherPlayerCompleted = false;

        quizActive = false;

        currentQuestions = [];

 

        database.ref('quiz').remove();

 

        document.getElementById('playerSelect').style.display = 'block';

        document.getElementById('quizContainer').style.display = 'none';

        document.getElementById('finalResult').style.display = 'none';

        document.getElementById('quizContainer').innerHTML = '';

        document.getElementById('finalResult').innerHTML = '';

    }

 

    // ==============================================================

    // ЗАПУСК

    // ==============================================================

    window.onload = function() {

        renderCalendar();

        updateCarousel();

        loadWords();

        listenQuizUpdates();

    };

</script>
